rules.prepare:
# The options of Debian's rules, without the ones for its alternatives # (pager, editor) and with these differences: # # * NO_CURL, NO_EXPAT: curl is built after git. Without them git has no # helpers for http and https remotes. # * NO_GETTEXT: no translations. # * NO_TCLTK, NO_PYTHON: no gitk, git-gui and git-p4. # * NO_PERL_CPAN_FALLBACKS is not set: there is no package of the Perl # module Error, git installs its own copy. cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" cat > config.mak << EOF prefix = $AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX gitexecdir = $AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/git-core INSTALLDIRS = vendor CC = ${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-gcc AR = ${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-ar PERL_PATH = $AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/perl NO_OPENSSL = 1 NO_CURL = 1 NO_EXPAT = 1 NO_GETTEXT = 1 NO_TCLTK = 1 NO_PYTHON = 1 NO_CROSS_DIRECTORY_HARDLINKS = 1 NO_INSTALL_HARDLINKS = 1 USE_LIBPCRE2 = 1 V = 1 EOF
# As in Alpine: musl has no REG_STARTEND, and its iconv writes no byte # order mark. if [ "$AELTRA_LIBC_NAME" = "musl" ]; then cat >> config.mak << EOF NO_REGEX = YesPlease NO_SYS_POLL_H = 1 ICONV_OMITS_BOM = Yes EOF fi
rules.build: cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make -j"$AELTRA_PARALLEL_JOBS" all make -C contrib/subtree all
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install make -C contrib/subtree DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
install -d -m 0755 \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/bash-completion/completions" install -m 644 contrib/completion/git-completion.bash \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/bash-completion/completions/git" install -m 644 contrib/completion/git-prompt.sh \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/git-core/git-sh-prompt"
# As in Debian, which has these in packages of their own: the tools for # arch, cvs, svn and email, and gitweb. cd "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" for i in git-archimport git-cvs git-p4 git-svn git-send-email; do rm -f lib/git-core/$i* done rm -f bin/git-cvsserver rm -rf share/perl5/Git/SVN* share/gitweb
